text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Daring Tact was invited as the 
guest of honor 
to a party hosted by the URA.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone gathered here just for my sake. 
I need to live up to their expectations... 
don't I?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I must convey everything properly... 
...I have to speak well...
choice_data_list:
I'll be watching over you, so you'll be 
fine!

I'll be watching over you, so you'll be 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ! ...You're right!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please welcome our guest to the 
stage! 
She has left a monumental, shining 
hoofprint 
upon the history of the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact! Everyone, please give her 
a round of thunderous applause!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I am Daring Tact. It is an honor 
to be here with you all today.
choice_data_list:
(You're doing great, standing tall and 
proud!)

(You're doing great, standing tall and 
proud!)

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you all already know, but allow 
me 
to once again introduce the historic feat 
that Daring Tact has accomplished.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Namely—the complete domination of the 
Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Complete domination... that's incredible. 
Winning the Triple Tiara alone 
is unbelievable enough as it is...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
She won the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, 
and even clinched back-to-back Queen 
Elizabeth II Cups.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And she won the Victoria Mile too! 
Daring Tact's miler rating is an 
off-the-charts 120!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
—Truly an unprecedented, glorious triumph! 
Did you set your sights on accomplishing 
such a legendary 
feat right from the very beginning?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No... At first, I didn't even know 
which path I wanted to walk. However—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I chased after the ones I admired, 
with so many people pushing me forward...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to achieve something grand 
someday, 
to repay everyone for their faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And for it to come true in such a 
wonderful way 
is all thanks to...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, who always believed in my 
strength 
and guided me down this glorious path.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Moving forward, together with Trainer... 
I will continue to forge a new future!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her stage appearance concluded and 
the banquet began—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Daring Tact!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on completely conquering 
the Tiara route! 
You've achieved something utterly 
sensational!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I pay homage to your glorious hoofprints. 
Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It is truly marvelous. 
Congratulations, Daring Tact...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gathered around Daring Tact were—past 
Triple Tiara horsegirls. 
Their breathtaking, regal presence made me 
hesitate instinctively.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much for coming! 
And even a bouquet... I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ever since we clashed in the Japan Cup, 
I knew you were something special, but... 
you've surpassed anything I could have 
imagined!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Racing alongside Almond Eye that day 
gave me the strength to keep pushing 
forward after that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If my results have lived up to the legacy 
of all of you who walked the Triple Tiara 
path before me... 
then nothing could make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... while today's theme 
is complete domination, 
aren't you, well—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —completely undefeated up to this point?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, now that you mention it... 
I suppose I am.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose I am"?! If I had won every 
single race, 
I'd be jumping through the ceiling with 
joy!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I was focusing so hard on what was 
directly in front of me 
that I didn't really have time to look 
back at wins and losses.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Though... you're right. 
I haven't lost a single race up until 
now...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I guess I really am amazing!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —How utterly adorable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Tact, paint a picture for me. 
I want to see... your love.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes, gladly! 
I would love to join Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My. In that case, how about dining with 
me? 
I shall introduce you to an exceptional 
restaurant 
where one can efficiently intake protein.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I would also... like to talk 
a little more with Daring Tact. 
Perhaps over some chocolates...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Then I want to go shopping 
with Daring Tact! Let's check out 
all kinds of lovely brands together♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
I've received so many invitations.
choice_data_list:
Looks like your calendar will be packed 
for a while!

Looks like your calendar will be packed 
for a while!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It promises to be a wonderful time, 
and I feel truly honored.
